title: Preserve known untracked fixture bytes independently of owner samples
outcome: Strengthen source-preservation regressions so a content-only mutation of an existing known untracked fixture file is detected independently of scripted source_id samples; do not use these byte snapshots to derive source identity.
acceptance: A preservation regression detects a byte-only change to its known untracked fixture input while the Git status path and scripted owner sample remain unchanged, and retains an unchanged positive control.
